architecture.mechanism: Rule-driven ad hoc forwarding scheme that maintains network function despite fragment failures
architecture.intervention: Implement a rule-driven redundant signal routing architecture within the engine management system where accelerator pedal position sensor data is forwarded to the ECU via multiple independent communication paths using predefined deterministic rules, ensuring that if one path fails intermittently, an alternative path delivers the acceleration command without interruption.
architecture.expected_effect: Intermittent stalling during acceleration is eliminated because the loss of any single sensor signal path does not result in a loss of throttle command, while normal acceleration performance and drivability are preserved through deterministic rule-based selection of valid signals.
architecture.falsification_test: Physically disconnect or electrically interrupt the primary accelerator pedal position sensor circuit during a controlled dynamometer acceleration run and verify that the engine does not stall and continues to follow the commanded throttle profile using the secondary routed signal.
